text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I went hiking in the mountains to refresh myself,
when I heard a familiar voice from the suspension bridge...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, over there...! Tachyon-san,
I see what looks like that wild vegetable on the opposite shore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, really? Splendid work, Yukino-kun!
Let us begin gathering samples right away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat!? If it ain't Trainer!
To run into you in mountains like this... what a coincidence!
(Rip rip rip! CRASHHHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, well, look at this.
It seems your way back is gone, isn't it?"

It turns out the two came to forage for wild edibles...
Agnes Tachyon apparently enlisted Yukino Bijin's help in search of plants containing special compounds.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like my phone has no service either.
Knowing I can't go home suddenly made me hungry.
Does anyone have any snacks on them?
choice_data_list: What do we do? Don't tell me we're stranded...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Listen, you two, panicking and making a fuss at times like this is just a waste of stamina!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any sweets on me, but first, let's fill our bellies.
Leave this part to me, y'hear!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—I caught a landlocked salmon!
Phew~, I'm so glad there was a river back there!
Come on, let's put it in the bamboo and make a hot pot!
choice_data_list: W-What, is there anything I can help with...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ye kindly!
Alright then, please go gather some dry firewood!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san, could you wash the wild vegetables?
Once I clean the fish, I'll add the mushrooms and make a hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Aren't wild mountain vegetables bitter...?
Good grief, I have zero motivation for this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, we'll draw out the bitterness.
See, if you give it a quick wash, it'll be done in no time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I grew up in the mountains, after all~.
I'm plenty used to this kind of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back when I lived at home, my grandpa and grandma taught me all sorts of things—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Look here, Yuki-chan, silverberry fruit's growin'. If ya ever get lost in the mountains, eat this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, there's wild boar tracks here.
Look at 'em and ya can tell which way it went.
You oughta remember this too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! You two really know everythin'♪
Hey, hey, can we eat this grass here...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—So you see, I know all about the mountains!
Please rely on me as much as you need at times like this!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait...
Hmm...? What's that sound...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A deer? A boar...? No.
Could it be... a bear?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... An Umamusume's legs could potentially outrun it, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Both of you, slowly get behind me...
Don't make any sudden moves, just back away bit by bit...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...If it comes down to it, I'll kick its nose to stall it, so Tachyon-san, you grab Trainer and run.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ......! Here it comes...!

text_block_list.name: Climber A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! I knew I smelled something delicious!
To think you'd be out here on the 'Ultra-Expert Mountain Trail'—
you folks really know your stuff, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so utterly shook, I tell ya~~~!
To think I actually said "Maybe it's a bear"...!
choice_data_list: No, thank you for protecting me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so utterly shook, I tell ya~~~!
To think I actually said "Maybe it's a bear"...!
choice_data_list: No, thank you for protecting me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...! Whoaaaaa~...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yukino-kun?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I was s-so relieved my legs gave out on meeee...!!

She appeared calm, but of course bears are terrifying.
Seeing her look so relieved filled my heart with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, pull yourself together. Honestly...
I can never tell if you're strong or just terribly fragile...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh...! That was so scaryyy~!
I'm so glad I'm aliveee~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, no, seriously, nothin' dangerous actually
happened at all! No bears, no gettin' lost...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?
It is an undeniable fact that your presence brought immense
peace of mind to those around you during the emergency.
choice_data_list: Thanks to that, I was able to stay calm and take action.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that really true~~?!
If it was helpful, I'm so glad...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Well then, shall we grab some hot pot before heading back?
I'm just so, so glad everyone's safe and sound, I am.
